items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: 129th Street and Lenox downstairs there was a club.

ctx.x: The fall of '29. I think the summer of '29 when we played Atlantic City. That was the summer of '29 -- 1929. We came into New York of the winter of -- like September. You know, after Atlantic City closed we came into New York with the band. We played 129th Street. It was a private club -- Barron's. Was a 129th Street and Lenox downstairs there was a club. It was a private club. It was put up by these real estate fellows. They had released it out to just people at formal dances and things. We played like four or…
